# Keeps Formula/mindfork.rb at mindfork's latest release with a macOS build —
# this tap's Excavator. Every six hours (and by hand): bump.py renders the
# formula for the latest release; when that changes it, the formula is
# installed from a tap of this very commit and its test run, as a user's
# `brew install` would, and only then pushed. No secret: the workflow's own
# token reads the public release and pushes to this repository.
name: Bump the formula

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "formula.rb.in"
      - "bump.py"
      - ".github/workflows/bump.yml"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: bump
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - name: The script's own arms
        run: python3 bump.py --self-test
      - name: Render the formula for the latest release
        id: render
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 bump.py
      - name: Commit it
        if: steps.render.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add Formula/mindfork.rb
          git commit -m "mindfork ${{ steps.render.outputs.version }}"
      # A tap of this commit — the formula exactly as it would be published —
      # installed and tested the way a user installs it.
      - name: Install it and run it
        if: steps.render.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: "1"
          HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: "1"
        run: |
          brew tap vshylov/tap "$PWD"
          brew install vshylov/tap/mindfork
          brew test vshylov/tap/mindfork
          mindfork --version
          test "$(mindfork --version)" = "mindfork ${{ steps.render.outputs.version }}"
      - name: Publish it
        if: steps.render.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: git push origin HEAD:main
